name: Pull Requests for GitHub
description: The pull request of the focused workspace in Orca's sidebar: what blocks the merge, the conversation with its images, checks, files and commits. The pull requests your agents and bots name or ask about are marked in the list, and Fix with agent hands a failing check or a review to them.

cover.alt: Merge blockers struck through down to Ready to merge, beside the panel showing a pull request ready to merge with its Merge button

screenshots.caption: What blocks the merge, unfolded: checks, conflicts and the merge method
screenshots.alt: The panel's status line unfolded: one check passed, no conflicts with main, the merge method, Convert to draft and Close
